platform: Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) with Coveo search; images on /content/dam/leviton/...
catalog_endpoint: Product sitemap https://leviton.com/sitemap-products.xml (18,598 URLs of form https://leviton.com/products/<sku-lowercase>); product page HTML has og:image (relative /content/dam/leviton/.../product_images/<family>/<SKU>.jpg). JSON-LD present but IndividualProduct block has no sku/image.
sku_format_match: yes - URL slug = SKU lowercased; 12/12 sample SKUs present in the product sitemap
recommended_strategy: Load sitemap-products.xml, map slug.upper() -> URL; for each needed SKU fetch https://leviton.com/products/<sku.lower()> (~700 KB HTML each, keep <=1-2 req/s) and take og:image, prefixed with https://leviton.com. Do not guess image paths from SKU: the DAM folder (commercial-industrial/residential/...) and family folder vary. Pages also embed related products' images, so use only og:image.
blockers: None observed (no bot challenge). Pages are heavy (~0.7 MB); robots.txt disallows Googlebot-Image but not /products for generic agents. 16A24-UY image ~93 KB JPEG (modest resolution).
